summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 UX fixes (tx status timeline, notifications→tx modal, developer webhooks auto-load + refetch-on-visible). All primary acceptance criteria PASS. Merchant 2FA login works. Transactions page rows open TransactionDetailsModal containing data-testid='tx-status-timeline' (with data-status), 'tx-status-banner', 'tx-status-banner-title', and the 4 progress steps 'tx-timeline-step-{created|received|confirmed|settled}' each carrying data-done + data-active. Notifications page opens the SAME modal with the timeline and renders a coherent state per notification (distinct for pending vs settled). Developer /developer-keys?tab=webhooks auto-loads webhook-settings/stats/history WITHOUT manual refresh. Simulated hidden→visible+focus past the 5s throttle re-fires 3 webhook requests, proving useRefetchOnVisible + SWR revalidateOnFocus. Modal Close + Invoice button regression intact.

verified.login_2fa: PASS — /auth/login → login-email-input → Continue → password-input → signin-submit-btn → login-2fa-dialog → TOTP via `node /app/backend/scripts/print_totp.cjs 1` → /dashboard.
verified.tx_timeline_settled: PASS — opened multiple settled rows (brand SMADAV). data-testid='tx-status-timeline' data-status='settled'; banner title 'Payment settled'; all 4 steps tx-timeline-step-{created,received,confirmed,settled} data-done='true'. tx-status-banner + tx-status-banner-title present.
verified.notifications_distinct_states: PASS — notification[0..2,4] opened settled tx (banner 'Payment settled'); notification[3] opened pending tx (data-status='pending', banner 'Awaiting payment — no funds received yet'). Confirmed distinct banner titles AND the awaiting-text does NOT leak into settled/confirmed states.
verified.developer_webhooks_autoload: PASS — /developer-keys?tab=webhooks renders data-testid='webhook-console' and auto-fires on mount (no manual refresh): /api/company/webhook-stats/71?days=30, /api/company/webhook-history/71?page=1&limit=20, /api/company/webhook-settings/71.
verified.refetch_on_visible: PASS — after waiting past the 5s focus throttle and dispatching visibilitychange hidden→visible plus window 'focus', the console re-fired 3 webhook requests: webhook-settings/71, webhook-stats/71?days=30, webhook-history/71?page=1&limit=20 (plus /api/company/getCompany). Confirms useRefetchOnVisible(loadSettings + refreshAll) + global SWRConfig revalidateOnFocus:true, focusThrottleInterval:5000.
verified.regression_close_and_invoice: PASS — modal close button (button[aria-label='Close transaction details']) closes the drawer; Invoice button renders on settled transactions.

not_tested: Confirmed/processing, underpaid, and failed timeline states were not surfaced in the live SMADAV/The Dev Store rows during this run (filter was dominated by settled rows + 1 pending notification). The spec explicitly allows this ('If the live account has only settled transactions, still verify the timeline renders correctly for those') — the 4-step helper buckets live in /app/helpers/txStatus.ts and the component paths are static.
Admin console auto-refresh was skipped per request (optional/best-effort; requires separate 2FA enrolment).
critical_code_review_comments: data-testid='webhook-stats' and 'webhook-deliveries' are rendered inside WebhookConsoleSection ONLY on view='events' (Events log tab), not on view='settings' (Webhooks tab). The task note says 'and/or' so this is acceptable, but if either testid should also appear on the settings view, main agent may want to adjust.

Timeline component correctly hides the progress rail for failed/expired buckets by returning only the banner (verified via source inspection of TxStatusTimeline.tsx); no failed tx was available to confirm visually in this live account.
test_credentials: Merchant onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@ with TOTP (`node /app/backend/scripts/print_totp.cjs 1`). Preview URL: https://vault-setup-17.preview.emergentagent.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The brand active in this session was SMADAV (33 txs, mostly settled). To see non-settled timeline buckets in the Transactions table (confirmed, underpaid, failed), either switch to a brand with more state diversity or use a notification that references such a payment. Developer webhooks tab is at /developer-keys?tab=webhooks (NOT /developer or /developers). Status chip filters on /transactions ('All 33', 'Settled 14', 'Unpaid 19') are not standard <button> text — a programmatic click on text=/^Unpaid$/ fails; use page.get_by_role('tab'|'button', name=/Unpaid/) or click by nearest testid if added.
